title: The Sylex Blast
summary: The destruction of Argoth ends the Brothers’ War and changes Dominaria.
narrative: The final confrontation on Argoth culminated in Urza activating the Golgothian Sylex, releasing catastrophic magical energy.
The blast ended the war, ignited Urza’s planeswalker spark, and helped precipitate the prolonged climatic disruption associated with the Ice Age.

The Sylex's earlier origin is not settled by the later account of its activation. In the official Brothers' War retrospective, Teferi encounters incompatible explanations involving Feldon, Ashnod, and Gix, even as the accounts converge on Urza's use of the device on Argoth. Those competing origin traditions should not be collapsed into a single established creator; the retrospective's 4562 AR framing dates Teferi's investigation, not the blast.
